player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely declared "DONE" while in the Craft room, failing to realize that the "west" direction was still unexplored from that location. My previous path (Craft -> Playroom -> Wine cellar -> Conservatory -> Wine cellar -> Playroom -> Home theater -> Dining room -> Craft) only covered a subset of the map. Next time, I will maintain a mental log of visited rooms and, crucially, track which specific directions have been attempted from each room. Before issuing "DONE", I will verify that every available direction from my current location and all previously visited locations has been traversed. Specifically, upon returning to the Craft room, I must execute "GO: west" instead of stopping, ensuring all branches of the map are fully explored.
